snippet.title: Kinstrife Announcement Trailer | Medieval Strategy RPG
snippet.description:
Become a wandering knight in the midst of the political turbulence of 13th century Germany, journeying to castles and towns in your quest for fortune & glory. Build your wealth, equipment, and following, fight in battles and tournaments, and carve out your destiny in a time of strife!
